# Shambhave Wellness

> Shambhave Wellness is a clinical psychology practice in Gurugram, Haryana, India, founded and led by Dr. Amita Puri, Clinical Psychologist. It offers in-person sessions in Gurugram and online therapy for clients in India and abroad, with a focus on narcissistic abuse recovery, trauma, relationships and anxiety.

Expert clinical psychologist in Gurgaon offering online counselling, therapy, hypnotherapy, trauma recovery, and mental health services across India.

## Key facts

- Location: Orchid Petals, Sector 49, Gurugram, Haryana 122018, India
- Phone: +919315311334
- Email: info@shambhavewellness.org
- Languages: English, Hindi

## Courses and training

- [Foundational Wellness & Healing Programs | Shambave Wellness](https://shambhavewellness.org/course/foundational-wellness-healing-programs): Provides a comprehensive blueprint for holistic well-being, integrating nutrition, somatic practices, sleep hygiene, and stress physiology.
- [Psychodiagnosis Masterclass in Clinical Assessment](https://shambhavewellness.org/course/psychodiagnosis-the-masterclass-in-clinical-assessment): Six month masterclass for practitioners on psychological assessment, diagnostic testing and case formulation. Online and offline. See course details.
- [Dark Psychology & Behavioral Manipulation Course](https://shambhavewellness.org/course/dark-psychology-behavioral-manipulation): A 6 month course on manipulative tactics and Dark Triad traits, taught online and offline. Read the course details and write to us to enquire.
- [Advanced Clinical Study of Personality Disorders](https://shambhavewellness.org/course/personality-disorders-advanced-clinical-study): Gain in-depth knowledge of personality disorders, diagnosis, treatment approaches, and clinical case management strategies at Shambhave Wellness.
- [Clinical Hypnotherapy Certification Training Course](https://shambhavewellness.org/course/clinical-hypnotherapy-certification): Become a certified hypnotherapist and learn subconscious mind techniques, hypnosis protocols, and therapeutic intervention methods from Shambhave Wellness.

- [SEHT Certification | Subconscious Energy Healing](https://shambhavewellness.org/course/seht-subconscious-energy-healing-therapy): Master Subconscious Energy Healing Therapy (SEHT) techniques to help clients overcome emotional blocks and achieve holistic wellness at Shambhave Wellness.

- [Psycho Astro Therapy (PAT) Certification Course](https://shambhavewellness.org/course/psycho-astro-therapy-pat-certification): Learn Psycho Astro Therapy techniques at Shambhave Wellness that integrate psychological insights and astrological principles for holistic guidance.
- [Boundary Enhancement Therapy](https://shambhavewellness.org/course/boundary-enhancement-therapy): Six month training in Boundary Enhancement Therapy by Dr. Amita Puri for mental health professionals. Online and offline. See the course details.
- [Narcissism in Clinical Practice](https://shambhavewellness.org/course/narcissism-in-clinical-practice): Six month advanced training for mental health and healthcare professionals on assessing and working with narcissistic presentations. See course details.
